sources.title: Introducing GPT-5.2
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. December 11, 2025 launch identifies GPT-5.2 Pro and gpt-5.2-pro separately from Thinking/Instant, with configurable medium/high/xhigh reasoning and explicit Pro benchmark columns. No nominal total or active parameter count or count-bearing named base is given.

sources.title: GPT-5.2 Pro model
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026, and read the complete exact-model Markdown. Identifies gpt-5.2-pro-2025-12-11, 400,000-token context, 128,000 maximum output, text/image input, text output, medium/high/xhigh effort, Responses-only access and function calling. It provides no nominal total or active parameter count.

sources.title: File inputs
sources.evidence: Responses accepts input_file items. For vision-capable models, PDF processing supplies both extracted text and page images. This applies to the exact Pro model through its documented Responses and image-input support; PDF is a supported file format, not an additional native sensory modality.

sources.title: Update to GPT-5 System Card: GPT-5.2
sources.evidence: Reopened original PDF October 27, 2026 and inspected the full extracted text, especially sections 1-2. The December 11, 2025 card describes GPT-5.2 Instant/Thinking and general data/reinforcement-learning training; it gives no total or active parameter counts or count-bearing Pro/base lineage. It does not establish exact Pro architecture.

sources.title: Introducing GPT-5.4
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Later original benchmark tables label GPT-5.2 Pro separately, including GDPval 74.1% and GPQA Diamond 93.2%. The exact Pro comparison columns and pricing row supply neither nominal total nor active parameter counts.

sources.title: GeneBench: Assessing AI Agents for Multi-Stage Inference Problems in Genomics and Quantitative Biology
sources.evidence: Reopened original April 23, 2026 PDF October 27 and inspected full extracted text, methods, Figure 4 and Supplementary Table 2. Exact GPT-5.2 Pro is evaluated under a separate Pro harness, with 10.8% pass rate; no nominal total/active counts or count-bearing base relationship are stated. Harness configuration and benchmark scores are not model size evidence.

sources.title: Prompt caching 201
sources.evidence: Guide explicitly applies to models before GPT-5.6. Explains prompt caching as key/value tensors in Transformer attention layers and heads, and lists gpt-5.2 in its model table. It does not independently establish an exact gpt-5.2-pro-to-gpt-5.2 checkpoint relationship.

sources.title: GPT-5.2 model
sources.evidence: The separate gpt-5.2 model page explicitly lists prompt_caching. This corroborates caching for Thinking, not a structural inference for the separately identified Pro model without an explicit underlying-model relationship.

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: Current agreement grants limited use of hosted services while reserving service intellectual-property rights to OpenAI (section 9.1). Together with the exact model being supplied through paid OpenAI API/ChatGPT access, supports descriptive proprietary classification rather than an open-weight license.

sources.title: ChatGPT release notes — June 12, 2026
sources.evidence: The June 12, 2026 entry explicitly retires GPT-5.2 Instant, Thinking and Pro from ChatGPT, migrating existing conversations to corresponding GPT-5.5 models. This is a ChatGPT retirement, not an API shutdown statement.

sources.title: Deprecations
sources.evidence: Current complete Markdown deprecation listing was checked for the exact Pro alias and dated snapshot. It contains GPT-5.2 Chat and Codex shutdown entries but no exact gpt-5.2-pro or gpt-5.2-pro-2025-12-11 shutdown entry. Absence of a notice does not independently test endpoint operation.

sources.title: Step 3.5 Flash: Open Frontier-Level Intelligence with 11B Active Parameters — Table 5
sources.evidence: Reopened original report October 27, 2026. Table 5 has separate Activated params and Total params rows; both are dashes for the GPT-5.2 xHigh column. That label does not establish exact Pro identity, and the table supplies no number to transfer. This is an original comparison-table check, not an OpenAI disclosure.

sources.title: Incompressible Knowledge Probes: Estimating Black-Box LLM Parameter Counts via Factual Capacity
sources.evidence: Fresh search lead reopened October 27, 2026. The July 5 revision explicitly measures effective knowledge capacity from external behavioral probes; its exact GPT-5.2 Pro estimate is approximately 639B with a 200B-2.0T prediction band. The author says these are not literal architecture and has no internal vendor access. Its inferred Pro/base lineage likewise comes from behavioral fingerprints. Neither is a developer specification, documented named-base size inference, or nominal activated-parameter benchmark convention; rejected as a parameter-count source.

name.note: Exact developer name; distinct from GPT-5.2 Thinking and Instant.

family.note: The launch places Pro within the GPT-5.2 series; replaces the generic gpt-pro grouping.

release_date.note: Earliest explicit public release found: December 11 announcement says API access is available that day. The exact dated snapshot agrees; ChatGPT rollout timing does not delay the API release.

open_weights.note: Exact model is distributed as a proprietary hosted API/ChatGPT service; no downloadable checkpoint is supplied in these primary release and model materials.

license.note: Descriptive hosted-model classification, not an SPDX identifier or a claim that the current service agreement was the launch-day version.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 review of exact Pro documentation, original family card, later OpenAI comparisons and GeneBench found no published nominal total or count-bearing named-base lineage. The IKP behavioral capacity estimate is not a model specification. StepFun lists no count for its differently labeled GPT-5.2 xHigh comparison.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 review found no separate nominal active count for exact GPT-5.2 Pro. StepFun's explicit activated-parameter row is blank for GPT-5.2 xHigh, which is not an established Pro identity. Reasoning effort, Pro harness configuration and the IKP effective-capacity estimate do not establish activated parameters.

architecture.note: Exact-model searches covering first-party training and interpretability material, the original system card, later Pro comparisons and GeneBench found no verifiable Pro structure. The base gpt-5.2 supports Transformer KV caching, but no explicit Pro-to-that-checkpoint relationship was established. Neither inference compute nor absence of Pro cached pricing establishes or rules out Transformer/MoE structure.

context_window.note: Exact Pro page labels 400,000 as context window and separately 128,000 as maximum output. No independent maximum input is derived by subtraction; the >128k input rate-limit tier is not the context maximum.

modalities.note: Native documented inputs are text and image, with text output. Add PDF as an API-supported file input via Responses vision processing. Image-generation tool support does not make image a native model output, and no native audio/video support is asserted.

reasoning.note: Exact GPT-5.2 Pro supports reasoning tokens and medium, high, xhigh effort. The original GPT-5 Pro high-only limitation and the Thinking model none/low options do not apply here.

tool_call.note: Exact Pro documentation lists function calling, file search, image generation, MCP and web search through Responses. Function calling is directly documented, not inferred from benchmark performance.

description.value: GPT-5.2 Pro reasoning model with text and image input, function calling, and a 400,000-token context window.
description.note: Replace subjective higher-accuracy/tougher-workflow wording with directly documented capabilities.

patch.description: GPT-5.2 Pro reasoning model with text and image input, function calling, and a 400,000-token context window.
patch.notes: API snapshot: gpt-5.2-pro-2025-12-11. Documented context window: 400,000 tokens; maximum output: 128,000 tokens. Supports reasoning effort medium, high and xhigh through Responses. PDF input is processed into text and page images. Total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed; no supported nominal count or count-bearing base lineage was found. Pro architecture remains unverified. ChatGPT retired GPT-5.2 Pro on June 12, 2026. No exact Pro API shutdown notice was found in the current deprecation list; endpoint operation was not tested.

notes: Parameter-only re-audit on October 27, 2026 by /root/parameters_426. Reopened the exact launch/API material, original family system card, later GPT-5.4 Pro comparisons and GeneBench; read the full cached primary texts. Fresh searches covered exact GPT-5.2 Pro parameter counts and activated/total comparisons. Independently read StepFun Table 5: GPT-5.2 xHigh has dashes for both counts, and exact Pro identity is not assumed. Read and rejected the newly surfaced IKP effective-capacity and behavioral-lineage estimates; they are not published nominal model counts. No supported count-bearing named base was found, so no lineage inference is available; no deployment or tensor-census attestation is required. Keep both counts unresolved. All other twelve field assessments are unchanged from the original audit.
summary: October 27 parameter re-audit: keep total and active counts null/undisclosed after original-source rereading and fresh later-disclosure searches. Exact OpenAI Pro materials provide no nominal counts; StepFun's differently labeled GPT-5.2 xHigh row is blank, and IKP behavioral capacity estimates are unsuitable as specifications. Explicitly patch both counts and parameters_source to null. Preserve the other twelve assessments, including the original family/license/PDF/description corrections and API-versus-ChatGPT distinction.
